tips.todayVolume: Definition: Total successful executions today across all live processes (excludes failed/timeout).
tips.todayHoursSaved: Formula: Today successful runs × standard manual hours per process. Unit: hours.
tips.totalHoursSaved: Definition: All-time cumulative hours saved (same formula).
tips.funnel:
Stages:
• Submitted: business submits requirement
• Reviewed: passed requirement review
• Developed: development started
• Launched: process released to production
• Accepted: business acceptance passed
tips.typeShare: Share of currently running processes grouped by requirement business line.
tips.progress:
Total = sum of all status counts.
• Submitted: awaiting review
• Approved: ready to develop
• Developing: in progress
• Running: live in production
• Completed: business accepted
tips.volumeTrend: Monthly successful execution counts of live processes.
tips.hoursTrend: Monthly hours saved (successful runs × standard hours).
tips.deptRequirementCount: Total requirements submitted by this department.
tips.deptHoursSaved: Cumulative hours saved by all processes of this department.
tips.deptCostSaved: Hours saved × department hourly cost rate.
tips.monthlyDeliveredRequirement: Definition: requirements that passed business acceptance this month.
tips.monthlyDeliveredProcess: Definition: automation processes newly released or updated this month.
tips.avgCycleDaysRequirement: Definition: average days from 'Approved' to 'Launched' for delivered requirements.
tips.avgCycleDaysProcess: Definition: average days from process creation to first release.
tips.developerCountRequirement: Developers who delivered at least one requirement this month.
tips.developerCountProcess: Developers who released at least one process this month.
tips.capacityTrend: Monthly comparison of requirements delivered vs processes released.
tips.progressBuckets:
Three buckets:
• Pending = Submitted + Approved
• Developing
• Done+Running = Running + Completed
tips.estimatedHours: Sum of estimated hours from FEAT-023.
tips.growthVsHours: Dual axis line: left growth rate %, right hours saved; historical only.
tips.accuracyScatter: Each dot is a process; closer to y=x means more accurate estimation.
tips.activeDeveloperCount: Developers who submitted processes in the period.
tips.timeoutProcessCount: Processes whose actual hours exceed estimate by >25%.

permissions.notice: Sharing Center registers 12 SC_* permission points (naming: SC_{ENTITY}_{ACTION}) to the APA permission engine. hasPermission() checks are served by APA AuthContext. Role bindings can be adjusted in the APA admin console.

points.SC_ASSET_VIEW: Browse/search/filter assets and view asset details (including version history & reuse records).
points.SC_ASSET_REUSE: Reuse assets (direct use/adapt) and view my reuse records.
points.SC_ASSET_EDIT: Edit metadata of own NATIVE assets (non-publisher cannot edit).
points.SC_DISPLAY_EDIT: Edit display wrapper (cover/displayName/desc/overview/video) for assets of all sources.
points.SC_PUBLISH_SUBMIT: Submit publishing approval (NATIVE initial + every DEV_CENTER aggregated reference).
points.SC_PUBLISH_FEATURE: Feature published assets and push notifications to target roles (P1).
points.SC_APPROVAL_VIEW: View approval queue (pending) and approval history.
points.SC_ADMIN_RULE: Configure approval levels per asset type (level 0 exempt / level 1 review).
